notes: §2002:11.2.3 GR3 forbids a FINAL class only as a superclass: at --std 2002 a FINAL class that inherits from a non-FINAL class runs its inherited and own methods (BASE-HELLO, FINAL-OWN as derived), and a class naming a FINAL class in INHERITS is refused (COBOL2791, §2002:11.2.2 SR5; g2002-gr-11-2-3-3-final-class-as-superclass).
